scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: As long as you remember these three, I can guarantee you will lead a good life in the future. Okay?

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: The three most important abilities for work: the first is flexibility, the second is accumulation, and the third is understanding human nature.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: What is flexibility? When you are being criticized by others, don't care about what others say; do whatever you want, right?

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Flexibility is the ability to be anti-fragile. There is a book called 'Antifragile' written by Taleb. What is anti-fragility? Many people say that living in society, we all have to be very tough and hard.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: So what is anti-fragility? Like under great pressure, you throw a ping pong ball down hard. Will it bounce back? It will.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: So what you need to cultivate is the flexibility of life. When work gives you pressure, you need to bounce back and surpass it.

scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.audio: This is the ability you need to cultivate in your life. It's not about saying 'I'm very strong,' 'I can endure,' or 'I'm easily wronged.' That's not being powerful. Truly powerful people possess flexibility.
